notes: No new stable simulator regression was found.
Core2 network improved from the r3 initial 13/14 to 14/14 on the first r4 concurrent run.
All Device Service sessions, QEMU processes and BLE peers were cleaned up.
The first documentation CI run failed only because the local snapshot mixed in uncommitted concurrent-agent test and source counts; the clean-tree snapshot fix is bound to the final result commit.
Raw serial, frames, PCM, pcap and evidence ZIPs remain outside source Git.
This record does not close stock SDK defects, StopWatch/StickS3 stock GATT, Core2 legacy RUNTIME-03 or physical validation.
